title: SHEIN — Official promo code
content: How to redeem a Promo Code? Step 1 At checkout, fill in your shipping address, choose a payment method and shipping option. If you have a valid Promo Code, simply enter the Promo Code into the Promo Code box. If you have bonus points or your Wallet Balance is not empty, you may also apply points to the order or check the Wallet Balance box. Step 2 Proceed to click CONTINUE CHECKOUT to pay for the now discounted order.
